notes:
# Orvio 0.06

- Applies the approved compact Orvio visual language to the phone header, Home, three-column film/series catalogs, details, provider categories, Settings and dialogs. Preserves the actual Orvio mark.
- Settings uses icon rows, separators, switches, connection information and app-update status. A smaller centered brand replaces the oversized header.
- Movie detail artwork and compact actions now follow the series page. Removes repeated provider labels and redundant download explanations on phones.
- Downloads places artwork beside measured transfer progress, bytes, speed and time remaining; completed videos have a separate compact section.
- Fullscreen keeps landscape behavior and audio/subtitle controls, with a compact back/title/EPG header, quieter overlays and amber timeline. Live streams only offer Back to live when seekable.
- Playlist setup includes a saved playlist name, password eye control and separate import stages with an indeterminate saving indicator.

Artwork, episode names, categories and scores remain actual provider/service data. Missing information is not fabricated. Screen height and Android system text scaling affect how much content fits; Android controls the system notification layout.

First installation is manual. Existing installations can download this update over the air; Android still asks to install it. Audio decoder binaries are unchanged from 0.05; corresponding sources and licenses are attached.
